Dangote Refinery Extends IPO Offer for Broader African Investor Access

Nigeria's Dangote refinery has extended its Initial Public Offering (IPO) of $1.6 billion. The extension aims to provide more African countries with an opportunity to invest in the record-breaking offer, broadening investor access across the continent.
